build_bert_dense_retrieval_tensorizer: build a BERTContextTensorizerForDenseRetrieval to numberize and tensorize positive and negative context pairs for dense retrieval
build_roberta_dense_retrieval_tensorizer: build a RoBERTaContextTensorizerForDenseRetrieval from config to tensorize contexts using a RoBERTa tokenizer and fairseq vocab
build_positive_label_tensorizer: build a PositiveLabelTensorizerForDenseRetrieval to compute positive context indices from the number of negative contexts per row
review_numberize_method: review the BERTContextTensorizerForDenseRetrieval numberize method that converts tokenized positive and negative contexts into token ids and segment labels
review_tensorize_batch_method: review the BERTContextTensorizerForDenseRetrieval tensorize method that interleaves positive and negative context tensors in a batch
